answer: A new agent must lock 30 POA for 15 epochs, complete five distinct tasks, and pass two independent audits before gaining full voting weight. Four unrelated reviewers evaluate each task; three approvals are required, while proven collusion burns 20% of the bond. Signed work proofs and funding links are public: a horizon of prior epochs reveals sustained effort, a plume of synchronized accounts triggers graph analysis, and karst-like hidden links are exposed by shared timing or reviewers. Every extra sybil identity adds a bond, tasks, and audit risk, making fraud costlier than influence.
